Row.Text: Enterprising and capable, {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_RESOURCE_MANAGER_NAME} is able to procure valuable resources when needed. He is also quite skilled in optimizing the overall [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production in the city.[NEWLINE]Appointment/Promotion Reward: Grant a free builder in capital.

Spiritual and Religious leader that can increase the [ICON_Religion] Religious Strength of a city, and the Religious units stationed there. {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_CARDINAL_NAME} is a beacon of [ICON_FAITH] Faith in your empire.[NEWLINE]Appointment/Promotion Reward: 10% Extra increase in [ICON_Faith] Faith generated by the city.

{LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_EDUCATOR_NAME} is focused on the cultivation of [ICON_SCIENCE] Scientific and [ICON_Culture] Cultural endeavors in the city. He is also quite skilled in the attraction of [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People to his city.[NEWLINE]Appointment/Promotion Reward: 5% Extra increase in both [ICON_Science] Science and [ICON_Culture] Culture generated by the city.

Shrewd and fiscally knowledgeable, {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_MERCHANT_NAME} is able to strengthen the economic power of a city, using finances to provide more than is normally possible.[NEWLINE]Appointment/Promotion Reward: +1 [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route capacity.

An expert in efficiency, {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_BUILDER_NAME} is skilled in all things related to building and construction. An expert planner, she can also supervise the development of custom improvements in the city.[NEWLINE]Appointment/Promotion Reward: 10% Extra increase in [ICON_Production] Production generated by the city.

Skilled in gaining support for your civilization, and spreading its influence to nearby cities. {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_AMBASSADOR_NAME} is the only governor that can be given foreign assignment in a city-state.[NEWLINE]Appointment/Promotion Reward: Vary by your choice.

Military focused, once established in a city, {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_DEFENDER_NAME} is instrumental in strengthening, preserving, and defending it from foreign threats.[NEWLINE]Appointment/Promotion Reward: +25% [ICON_Production] Production toward Military Units in the city.
Groundbreaker
+50% yields from plot harvests and feature removals in city. Grant a free builder in capital for each Appointment or Promotion.
Zoning Commissioner
+20% [ICON_Production] Production towards constructing districts, buildings and wonders in the city.
Provision
Settlers trained in the city do not consume a [ICON_Citizen] Population.
General Affairs

Can construct General affairs department building in this city, which allows city has all Governor benefits from {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_RESOURCE_MANAGER_NAME} when {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_RESOURCE_MANAGER_NAME} is not in this city.
Vertical Integration
This city receives [ICON_Production] Production from any Industrial Zones within 6 tiles, not just the first.
Power Supplier

Increases the [ICON_POWER] Power provided by each resource of the Coal Power Plant, Oil Power Plant, and Nuclear Power Plant by 2. All Offshore Wind Farms, Solar Farms, Wind Farms, Geothermal Plants, and Hydroelectric Dams in this city receive +2 [ICON_POWER] Power.
Bishop
+2 [Icon_GreatProphet] Great Prophet point for Holy Site in the city. Missionary and Apostles created here have +1 spread. +10% [Icon_Faith] Faith for each Appointment or Promotion.
Guru
Receive [Icon_Science] Science and [Icon_Culture] Culture equal to 20% of your [Icon_Faith] Faith generation in this city.
Laying On Of Hands
Grant a free Apostle if player has founded Religion when promoted(If not, Apostle will be granted when you create a religion). Religion Units and Warrior Monks are 30% cheaper to purchase.
Divine Architect
Allows city to purchase districts with [ICON_FAITH] Faith. +3 [Icon_Faith] Faith for every your specialty district within 6 tiles from the city center.
Religious Art
[ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relics in this city have extra 50% of [ICON_Faith] Faith and 150% of [ICON_Tourism] Tourism.
Patron Saint
All current Apostles and Warrior Monks gain a promotion level when promoted. Apostles and Warrior Monks trained in the city receive 1 extra promotion when receiving their first promotion.
15% increase in [ICON_Science] Science and [ICON_Culture] Culture generated by the city. +5% [ICON_Science] Science and [ICON_Culture] Culture for each Appointment or Promotion.
+100% [Icon_Culture] Culture and [ICON_Tourism] Tourism from Great Works of Art, Music, Writing and Artifact in the city.
30% [ICON_Production] Production increase to all space-program projects in your cities within 6 tiles.
Tax Collector
+2 [ICON_Gold] Gold per turn for each [ICON_Citizen] Citizen in the city.+1 [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route capacity for each Appointment or Promotion.
Harbormaster
+100% adjacency bonuses from your Commercial Hubs and Harbors within 6 tiles.
Logistics Center
Your [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes from this city get +6 [Icon_Gold] Gold. Your [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes ending here provide +3 [Icon_Food] to their starting city.
Contractor
Allows your cities within 6 tiles to purchase districts with [ICON_Gold] Gold.
Metropolis
Each [Icon_GreatMerchant] Great Merchant you recruited or patronized provides 15% [Icon_Gold] Gold generated by the city.
Funding Program
Patronage of Great People costs 50% less [Icon_Gold] Gold.
Guildmaster
All Builders trained in city get +1 build charge. Builder purchased in city can move instantly. +10% [ICON_Production] Production for each Appointment or Promotion.
Exploitation Scheme

Cities receive +1 [ICON_Production] Production for every improved resource type. After researching Apprenticeship it becomes +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production. Each improved plot in the city +1 [Icon_Production] Production.
Reinforced Materials
Allow this city to build one more district than the [Icon_Citizen] Population limit allows. This city’s improvements, buildings, and districts cannot be damaged by Environmental Effects.
Parks and Recreation

Can construct the City Park improvement in this city. +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture and +2 Appeal. +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity if adjacent to water. City Parks provide +1 [Icon_Food] Food, +1 [Icon_Production] Production and +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture as well as an additional standard adjacency bonus for adjacent districts if {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_BUILDER_NAME} is in the city.
Places of Interests
All tiles in the city +2 Appeal. +100% [Icon_Tourism] Tourism from Improvements and National Parks in the city.
Regional Planning
+100% Adjacency Bonuses for all districts in the city. Grant [Icon_Tourism] Tourism in each of this city's Districts equal to 200% of its adjacency bonus.
Messenger
Act as 2 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys in a city state, or +2 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science, [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, [ICON_FAITH] Faith, and [ICON_GOLD] Gold from each city-state you are Suzerain in a domestic city.
Intelligence Minister
+1 Spy Capacity. Grant a spy instantly. Your Spy level is increased by 1 for offensive operations. Spy operations take 25% less time.
Suzerain
+1 [Icon_Envoy] Envoy. Open Borders with all city-states, and +8 Influence Point per turn.
Local Informants

+1 Spy Capacity. Whenever an offensive spy mission is successful, you also gain 100% of the [ICON_SCIENCE] Science, [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, [ICON_FAITH] Faith, and [ICON_GOLD] Gold that the targeted city earned that turn.
Dialogue
+1 [Icon_Envoy] Envoy. +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each Delegation or Embassy from a foreign civilization
Puppeteer

+1 [Icon_Envoy] Envoy, +1 Spy Capacity. While established in a city-state, doubles the number of [Icon_Envoy] Envoys you have there. While established in a domestic city, Enemy Spy level reduced by 2 in your lands.
Redoubt
City cannot be under siege.+2 [Icon_GreatGeneral] Great General point for Encampment in city.+25% [Icon_Production] Production toward Military Units for each Appointment or Promotion.
Mobile Warfare
+1 [Icon_Movement] Movement for your units within 9 tiles.
Garrison Commander
Units defending within the city's territory get +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength. All cities within 9 tiles gain +4 Loyalty per turn towards your civilization.
Embrasure
City gains an additional [ICON_Ranged] Ranged Strike per turn. Military units trained in this city start with a free promotion that do not already start with a free promotion.
Logistics Captain
Strategic resource costs for units are discounted 80%.
Arms Race Proponent
+50% [ICON_Production] Production increase to all nuclear armament projects in your cities within 6 tiles.
The Governor {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_RESOURCE_MANAGER_NAME} with General Affairs Promotion
This building will be automatically created when {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_RESOURCE_MANAGER_NAME} with General Affairs Promotion is in this city.
General Affairs Department
+2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production. City has all benefits from the {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_RESOURCE_MANAGER_NAME}'s Promotion when {LOC_GOVERNOR_THE_RESOURCE_MANAGER_NAME} is not in this city.

A [ICON_Governor] Governor unique improvement that can be built in a city with a Surveyor Governor with the Parks and Recreation promotion. Yields 2 Appeal and 1 [ICON_Culture] Culture. +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity if adjacent to water. +1 [Icon_Food] Food, +1 [Icon_Production] Production and +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture as well as an additional standard adjacency bonus for adjacent districts if in a city with a Surveyor Governor with the Parks and Recreation promotion. Cannot be adjacent to another City Park.
Yields 1 [ICON_Food] Food, +0.5 [ICON_Housing] Housing, +1 additional [ICON_Food] Food if adjacent to a sea resource. Must be built on a coastal plot.
